title: Write a short essay
description: Structured writing on a news topic or debate.

items.prompt: Write a short paragraph (4–6 sentences) summarising a news story and your view.
items.promptIt: Scrivi un breve paragrafo (4–6 frasi) riassumendo una notizia e la tua opinione.

items.prompt: Write two sentences using a Second Conditional about a proposal.
items.promptIt: Scrivi due frasi con il Second Conditional su una proposta.
